Name: Casino hardwood
Author: YaBoiiDante
Description:
In the 1.16 concerned ape put a limit of 20 hardwood fences you can buy per day in the casino, which broke my hardwood farm, so i made this.
You will have the 20 hardwood fences, but if you scroll down you will see an unlimited supply at the same price as always. 

I'm just learning, most of the mod was made by someone else on the Krobus discord, so shoutout to Jessie. If any of you wants anything added to any store just tell me, it would be great practice!

Manifest.Description: just a patch to ingore the maximum hardwood fences you can buy from the casino
